summary: Add opt-in authenticated outbound home sessions for durable native Observe and Stop, with paired epoch fencing and replay

replay.detail: Session state uses a fresh versioned authoritative SQLite namespace. Existing full-node graph planning, replication and native start behavior are unchanged; no old graph or execution identity is replaced.

schema.detail: Private seat/home journals retain immutable sequenced decisions, native entry and final retirement proofs, receipts and ACKs, closed epochs, stable identities, retired floors, authority changes and request results. Capacities provide explicit backpressure. A durable native-finalization phase blocks terminal receipt delivery, ACK, checkpoint and epoch drain until exact physical-incarnation metadata finalization succeeds; live errors and restart retain the same witness. The existing authoritative local_session_custody table additively gains native_retirement_verified with a false default; prior bindings are retained without inventing physical proof.

rules.detail: Both endpoints require valid pinned Ed25519 member signatures, exact subject/operation grants and a durable control epoch. The upgrade request signs its actual WebSocket challenge; the response signs a fresh home nonce bound to that request. Every frame signs the resulting transcript, direction and strict sequence, and replayed headers cannot reserve a seat without a fresh signed Hello. Seat-initiated sessions drain retained receipts and authority changes before new work. Observe and Stop use current exact native custody; borrowed Stop detaches without signaling a shell. Start grants, configuration and commands explicitly return light-node-start-not-supported, with no enabled remote launch path. Program credentials stay host-local and forward request-bound assertions through the real home claim writer and retry-receipt transaction.

compatibility.detail: The protocol is versioned and mismatched versions, pins, scope and epochs fail closed. Unconfigured full nodes keep their existing startup and credential path. Do not roll an enabled journal back to a binary that does not enforce its authority and replay fences; retain its state and roll forward.

downtime.detail: This change performs no production deployment, membership retirement, graph offload or CPU-target claim. Transport loss does not stop native processes or PTYs.

manual.detail: Opt in with matching home/agent light_node_session configuration and the existing fleet identity. Command administration remains guarded owner-local Unix only. Keep the previous home endpoint and signing identity available until the paired receipt/authority/native-custody drain completes. Graph-free remote Start is the next separate reviewed slice, not an enabled fallback in this release.

recovery.detail: Reconnect and restart replay durable custody, never re-enter a retired execution or invent a replacement identity. An entered Stop without a native proof can reconcile only a positively identified current generation under the authority/cancellation barrier; ambiguous or replaced custody stays unresolved. Native custody admission remains atomic under the existing exclusive writer without invoking graph projection finalizers. A positively verified owned stop retains exact current-binding physical proof before returning; changed lifecycle/custody or replacement generations cannot inherit it. Unknown-entry recovery queries that proof without signalling an ended PTY again. A crash before proof persistence or an unmarked direct native stop remains unresolved. Positive final retirement snapshots survive a failed local metadata write and are repaired before delivery or reclamation; physical proof alone never substitutes for the command completion receipt. A revoked program dispatch uses fresh authorization identity on retry, while admission-ACK waits preserve their identity. A signed retained-epoch barrier-only response recovers a lost final Ready/ACK without permitting old work. Stable request retries retain their local/home result; sending an HTTP response is not consumer acknowledgement. The guarded native result-acknowledgement route requires the original execution/request digest and accepted result, releases bounded payload/result capacity only on explicit acceptance, retains identity tombstones, and makes lost-ACK retries idempotent. Real SQLite/network, native PTY, channel-replay and Bun fixtures cover these boundaries; hosted Linux evidence and exact-head independent review are required before treating the gates as verified.
